title: Testfile run record
description: The run.yaml a Testfile runner writes into .testfile/runs/<id>/. Describes one recorded test run: its outcome, the tests that executed, the services that were started, and the shape of the Testfile it came from. See spec/RESULTS.md for the normative description.

id.description: The run id; equals the folder name. Starts with the UTC timestamp at second resolution plus a random suffix, e.g. 20260802-193731-4bdc.

startedAt.description: Start time, ISO 8601 with milliseconds, UTC. Consumers order runs by this value, using the id as tie-breaker.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the whole run, in milliseconds.

status.description: Outcome of the run: passed, failed, or aborted (interrupted).

exitCode.description: The runner's exit code for this run: 0 passed, 1 failed, 130 interrupted.

cancelled.description: True when the run was interrupted (Ctrl+C or a timeout that stopped the run).

machine.description: Who ran the suite: a CI actor name, a GitHub login, or the hostname. Free-form identifier; consumers must not parse it.

variants.description: What distinguishes this run from a sibling run of the same suite, e.g. {"platform": "linux"} for one leg of a matrix. Set by the runner (--variant) and what merging uses to keep the legs apart.

labels.description: What the run should be findable by, e.g. {"branch": "main", "pr": "42"}. Set by the runner (--label). Keys and values are free-form; values are always strings.

merged.description: Present when this run was produced by merging others (testfile-viewer merge). The merged run is an ordinary run; this records what went into it.

runs.description: The merged runs, in the order they were combined.

variants.description: What distinguishes this run from a sibling run of the same suite, e.g. {"platform": "linux"} for one leg of a matrix. Set by the runner (--variant) and what merging uses to keep the legs apart.
Every variant value the merged runs used, per key, e.g. {"platform": ["linux", "macos"]}.

env.description: The resolved top-level `env` of the Testfile (may be empty). Secret values are masked.

fromEnvironment.description: What the environment contributed beyond the Testfile: variables handed in with TESTFILE_ENV_, the secret names masked in this run, and the document paths overridden with TESTFILE_CONFIG_. Absent when the environment added nothing.

variables.description: Names handed in with TESTFILE_ENV_ (the prefix stripped); their values are in `env` where the Testfile used them.

secrets.description: Names whose values were masked in this run: the Testfile's `secrets` that actually resolved, plus anything handed in with TESTFILE_SECRET_. Names only - never the values.

overrides.description: Values TESTFILE_CONFIG_ wrote into the document before the run, in the order they were applied.

path.description: Dotted path into the Testfile, e.g. "services.postgres.container.image".

from.description: The host variable it came from, so the run can be repeated verbatim.

value.description: What that variable held, masked like every other recorded value.

ports.description: The resolved named ports (may be empty).

selected.description: Test paths the user selected for this run; empty means the whole suite.

suite.description: The Testfile's test tree, including tests this run did not execute. Producers should record it; consumers must tolerate its absence.

tests.description: One entry per executed test, in execution order.

services.description: One entry per service that was started during the run.

junit.description: Relative path of the JUnit XML inside the run folder, usually junit.xml.

analysis.description: Someone's reading of why this run went the way it did, added after the run by a person or a tool. Never written by the runner; viewers show it as an annotation, not as a result.

text.description: The finding, in prose. Free-form; consumers display it and must not parse it.

author.description: Who wrote it, e.g. a person, a bot name or a model. Free-form identifier.

at.description: When it was written, ISO 8601 with milliseconds, UTC.

path.description: The test's path: names joined with "/" from the root, e.g. ci/checks/schema.

startedAt.description: Start time of this test, ISO 8601 with milliseconds, UTC; absent for tests that never started.

startedAfterMs.description: Milliseconds between the run's startedAt and this test's - how far into the run it began. Absent exactly when startedAt is.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration; absent for tests that never started.

log.description: Relative path of the test's merged stdout+stderr log; absent when the test produced no output.

artifacts.description: Relative paths of collected artifact files.

cached.description: True when the result was served from the runner's result cache.

reason.description: Why a test with `inputs` ran or was reused (cache hit/miss detail, change-based selection). Free-form; consumers must not parse it.

variants.description: What distinguishes this run from a sibling run of the same suite, e.g. {"platform": "linux"} for one leg of a matrix. Set by the runner (--variant) and what merging uses to keep the legs apart.

origin.description: Merged runs only: the id of the run this result came from.

name.description: The service name from the Testfile.

status.description: Last observed status of the service.

log.description: Relative path of the service's log; absent without output.

variants.description: What distinguishes this run from a sibling run of the same suite, e.g. {"platform": "linux"} for one leg of a matrix. Set by the runner (--variant) and what merging uses to keep the legs apart.

origin.description: Merged runs only: the id of the run this result came from.

path.description: Names joined with "/" from the root - the key tests[].path uses.

kind.description: What this node is: a leaf (command/script), a group (sequence/parallel) or the wrapper a matrix expands from.

tags.description: Tags declared on this test; tags of ancestors apply as well.

matrix.description: The combination of an expanded matrix instance, e.g. {node: "22"}.

services.description: Names of the services this test declares.

children.description: Nested nodes, in document order; absent on leaves.
